paragraphs.text:
When you announce your intent to divert the party, Charlie 
stares at you like you have lost your mind.
“It is madness to return to that evil place. I will not do so.”

To give up the idea and return to civilization, go to 593. To remind 
Charlie who pays her when the trip is over, go to 599.
